description: #paid joins claim_payments to #clm, and #clm only holds claims whose reported_date falls between @YearStart and @AsOfDate. Payments made in 2025 on claims reported in earlier years are dropped from claims_paid_eur, from paid_to_written and so from review_flag. A broker/LOB that only has such payments gets no output row at all.

impact.query: WITH pol AS (SELECT policy_id, broker_code, lob_code FROM (SELECT s.policy_id, COALESCE(UPPER(TRIM(s.broker_code)),'DIRECT') AS broker_code, UPPER(RTRIM(p.lob_code)) AS lob_code, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.policy_id ORDER BY s.snapshot_date DESC, s._row_seq DESC) AS rn FROM stg_policy_snapshots s JOIN stg_products p ON p.product_code = s.product_code WHERE s.snapshot_date <= DATE'2025-12-31') x WHERE rn = 1), paid_int AS (SELECT p.broker_code, p.lob_code, SUM(COALESCE(cp.amount,0)) AS paid FROM stg_claim_payments cp JOIN stg_claims c ON c.claim_id = cp.claim_id JOIN pol p ON p.policy_id = c.policy_id WHERE cp.payment_date >= DATE'2025-01-01' AND cp.payment_date <= DATE'2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.broker_code, p.lob_code), g AS (SELECT broker_code, lob_code, MAX(claims_paid_eur) AS paid FROM golden_rpt_broker_production GROUP BY broker_code, lob_code) SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_affected, COALESCE(SUM(ABS(COALESCE(i.paid,0) - COALESCE(g.paid,0))),0) AS amount_affected FROM paid_int i FULL OUTER JOIN g ON i.broker_code = g.broker_code AND i.lob_code = g.lob_code WHERE COALESCE(i.paid,0) <> COALESCE(g.paid,0)

impact_query: WITH pol AS (SELECT policy_id, broker_code, lob_code FROM (SELECT s.policy_id, COALESCE(UPPER(TRIM(s.broker_code)),'DIRECT') AS broker_code, UPPER(RTRIM(p.lob_code)) AS lob_code, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.policy_id ORDER BY s.snapshot_date DESC, s._row_seq DESC) AS rn FROM stg_policy_snapshots s JOIN stg_products p ON p.product_code = s.product_code WHERE s.snapshot_date <= DATE'2025-12-31') x WHERE rn = 1), paid_int AS (SELECT p.broker_code, p.lob_code, SUM(COALESCE(cp.amount,0)) AS paid FROM stg_claim_payments cp JOIN stg_claims c ON c.claim_id = cp.claim_id JOIN pol p ON p.policy_id = c.policy_id WHERE cp.payment_date >= DATE'2025-01-01' AND cp.payment_date <= DATE'2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.broker_code, p.lob_code), g AS (SELECT broker_code, lob_code, MAX(claims_paid_eur) AS paid FROM golden_rpt_broker_production GROUP BY broker_code, lob_code) SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_affected, COALESCE(SUM(ABS(COALESCE(i.paid,0) - COALESCE(g.paid,0))),0) AS amount_affected FROM paid_int i FULL OUTER JOIN g ON i.broker_code = g.broker_code AND i.lob_code = g.lob_code WHERE COALESCE(i.paid,0) <> COALESCE(g.paid,0)
intended_behaviour: claims_paid_eur should hold every payment dated in the year on the broker's policies, whenever the claim was notified. Only claims_notified should be limited by reported_date.
title: Claims paid limited to claims notified in the same year

description: The final insert LEFT JOINs stg.brokers on broker_code alone. Nothing picks one row per broker the way the policy snapshots and FX rates are deduplicated with _row_seq. A broker with several rows in stg.brokers (history or reloads) repeats every broker/LOB output row, along with its premium, claims and policy counts.

impact.query: WITH g AS (SELECT broker_code, lob_code, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(gwp_eur) AS gwp FROM golden_rpt_broker_production GROUP BY broker_code, lob_code) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(n - 1),0) AS rows_affected, COALESCE(SUM((n - 1) * ABS(gwp)),0) AS amount_affected FROM g WHERE n > 1

impact_query: WITH g AS (SELECT broker_code, lob_code, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(gwp_eur) AS gwp FROM golden_rpt_broker_production GROUP BY broker_code, lob_code) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(n - 1),0) AS rows_affected, COALESCE(SUM((n - 1) * ABS(gwp)),0) AS amount_affected FROM g WHERE n > 1
intended_behaviour: Exactly one output row per broker and LOB, using only the latest broker record.
title: Broker dimension joined without deduplication

description: ISNULL(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(broker_code))),'DIRECT') only catches NULL. A broker_code that is empty or all spaces trims to '' and is reported under an empty broker code, separately from DIRECT business.

impact.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_affected, COALESCE(SUM(ABS(gwp_eur)),0) AS amount_affected FROM golden_rpt_broker_production WHERE TRIM(broker_code) = ''

impact_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_affected, COALESCE(SUM(ABS(gwp_eur)),0) AS amount_affected FROM golden_rpt_broker_production WHERE TRIM(broker_code) = ''
intended_behaviour: Direct business, meaning a NULL or blank broker code, should all be reported under DIRECT (NULLIF(trimmed,'') before ISNULL).
title: Blank broker codes not mapped to DIRECT

description: The OUTER APPLY returns NULL when the currency has no rate dated on or before the transaction (or when currency is NULL). amount * NULL is NULL and SUM skips it, so the premium vanishes from gwp_eur and the paid-to-written ratio without any error.

impact.query: WITH pol AS (SELECT policy_id, broker_code, lob_code FROM (SELECT s.policy_id, COALESCE(UPPER(TRIM(s.broker_code)),'DIRECT') AS broker_code, UPPER(RTRIM(p.lob_code)) AS lob_code, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.policy_id ORDER BY s.snapshot_date DESC, s._row_seq DESC) AS rn FROM stg_policy_snapshots s JOIN stg_products p ON p.product_code = s.product_code WHERE s.snapshot_date <= DATE'2025-12-31') x WHERE rn = 1), t AS (SELECT t.txn_id, t.txn_date, UPPER(TRIM(t.currency)) AS currency, t.amount, p.broker_code, p.lob_code FROM stg_premium_transactions t JOIN pol p ON p.policy_id = t.policy_id WHERE t.txn_date >= DATE'2025-01-01' AND t.txn_date <= DATE'2025-12-31' AND (t.currency IS NULL OR UPPER(TRIM(t.currency)) <> 'EUR')), nr AS (SELECT t.* FROM t LEFT ANTI JOIN stg_fx_rates f ON UPPER(TRIM(f.currency)) = t.currency AND f.rate_date <= t.txn_date), fr AS (SELECT UPPER(TRIM(currency)) AS currency, MIN_BY(rate_to_eur, rate_date) AS r FROM stg_fx_rates GROUP BY UPPER(TRIM(currency))) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT nr.broker_code, nr.lob_code) AS rows_affected, COALESCE(SUM(ABS(nr.amount * COALESCE(fr.r, 1))),0) AS amount_affected FROM nr LEFT JOIN fr ON fr.currency = nr.currency

impact_query: WITH pol AS (SELECT policy_id, broker_code, lob_code FROM (SELECT s.policy_id, COALESCE(UPPER(TRIM(s.broker_code)),'DIRECT') AS broker_code, UPPER(RTRIM(p.lob_code)) AS lob_code, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.policy_id ORDER BY s.snapshot_date DESC, s._row_seq DESC) AS rn FROM stg_policy_snapshots s JOIN stg_products p ON p.product_code = s.product_code WHERE s.snapshot_date <= DATE'2025-12-31') x WHERE rn = 1), t AS (SELECT t.txn_id, t.txn_date, UPPER(TRIM(t.currency)) AS currency, t.amount, p.broker_code, p.lob_code FROM stg_premium_transactions t JOIN pol p ON p.policy_id = t.policy_id WHERE t.txn_date >= DATE'2025-01-01' AND t.txn_date <= DATE'2025-12-31' AND (t.currency IS NULL OR UPPER(TRIM(t.currency)) <> 'EUR')), nr AS (SELECT t.* FROM t LEFT ANTI JOIN stg_fx_rates f ON UPPER(TRIM(f.currency)) = t.currency AND f.rate_date <= t.txn_date), fr AS (SELECT UPPER(TRIM(currency)) AS currency, MIN_BY(rate_to_eur, rate_date) AS r FROM stg_fx_rates GROUP BY UPPER(TRIM(currency))) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT nr.broker_code, nr.lob_code) AS rows_affected, COALESCE(SUM(ABS(nr.amount * COALESCE(fr.r, 1))),0) AS amount_affected FROM nr LEFT JOIN fr ON fr.currency = nr.currency
intended_behaviour: Every written premium transaction should be converted, using a fallback rate or by failing or flagging the run, not dropped. The amount shown is estimated at the earliest available rate, or left unconverted if the currency has no rate at all.
title: Non-EUR premium silently dropped when no FX rate is found

description: The comment says recoveries are netted off, but the code sums every payment amount whatever its payment_type. If recoveries are stored as positive amounts with a recovery payment_type, they increase claims_paid_eur instead of reducing it.

impact.query: WITH pol AS (SELECT policy_id, broker_code, lob_code FROM (SELECT s.policy_id, COALESCE(UPPER(TRIM(s.broker_code)),'DIRECT') AS broker_code, UPPER(RTRIM(p.lob_code)) AS lob_code, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.policy_id ORDER BY s.snapshot_date DESC, s._row_seq DESC) AS rn FROM stg_policy_snapshots s JOIN stg_products p ON p.product_code = s.product_code WHERE s.snapshot_date <= DATE'2025-12-31') x WHERE rn = 1), clm AS (SELECT c.claim_id, p.broker_code, p.lob_code FROM stg_claims c JOIN pol p ON p.policy_id = c.policy_id WHERE c.reported_date >= DATE'2025-01-01' AND c.reported_date <= DATE'2025-12-31'), r AS (SELECT c.broker_code, c.lob_code, cp.amount FROM stg_claim_payments cp JOIN clm c ON c.claim_id = cp.claim_id WHERE cp.payment_date >= DATE'2025-01-01' AND cp.payment_date <= DATE'2025-12-31' AND UPPER(cp.payment_type) LIKE '%RECOV%' AND cp.amount > 0) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT broker_code, lob_code) AS rows_affected, COALESCE(SUM(2 * amount),0) AS amount_affected FROM r

impact_query: WITH pol AS (SELECT policy_id, broker_code, lob_code FROM (SELECT s.policy_id, COALESCE(UPPER(TRIM(s.broker_code)),'DIRECT') AS broker_code, UPPER(RTRIM(p.lob_code)) AS lob_code, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.policy_id ORDER BY s.snapshot_date DESC, s._row_seq DESC) AS rn FROM stg_policy_snapshots s JOIN stg_products p ON p.product_code = s.product_code WHERE s.snapshot_date <= DATE'2025-12-31') x WHERE rn = 1), clm AS (SELECT c.claim_id, p.broker_code, p.lob_code FROM stg_claims c JOIN pol p ON p.policy_id = c.policy_id WHERE c.reported_date >= DATE'2025-01-01' AND c.reported_date <= DATE'2025-12-31'), r AS (SELECT c.broker_code, c.lob_code, cp.amount FROM stg_claim_payments cp JOIN clm c ON c.claim_id = cp.claim_id WHERE cp.payment_date >= DATE'2025-01-01' AND cp.payment_date <= DATE'2025-12-31' AND UPPER(cp.payment_type) LIKE '%RECOV%' AND cp.amount > 0) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT broker_code, lob_code) AS rows_affected, COALESCE(SUM(2 * amount),0) AS amount_affected FROM r
intended_behaviour: Recovery-type payments should reduce claims paid (subtracted, or sign-flipped when stored as positives).
title: Recoveries added rather than netted off

description: stg.claims is used as-is in #clm. stg.policy_snapshots and stg.fx_rates are deduplicated with _row_seq, but claims are not. If a claim_id has several staging rows, it is counted more than once in claims_notified, and each of its payments is added once per duplicate in claims_paid_eur.

impact.query: WITH pol AS (SELECT policy_id, broker_code, lob_code FROM (SELECT s.policy_id, COALESCE(UPPER(TRIM(s.broker_code)),'DIRECT') AS broker_code, UPPER(RTRIM(p.lob_code)) AS lob_code, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.policy_id ORDER BY s.snapshot_date DESC, s._row_seq DESC) AS rn FROM stg_policy_snapshots s JOIN stg_products p ON p.product_code = s.product_code WHERE s.snapshot_date <= DATE'2025-12-31') x WHERE rn = 1), clm AS (SELECT c.claim_id, p.broker_code, p.lob_code FROM stg_claims c JOIN pol p ON p.policy_id = c.policy_id WHERE c.reported_date >= DATE'2025-01-01' AND c.reported_date <= DATE'2025-12-31'), d AS (SELECT claim_id, broker_code, lob_code, COUNT(*) AS n FROM clm GROUP BY claim_id, broker_code, lob_code HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), pay AS (SELECT claim_id, SUM(COALESCE(amount,0)) AS amt FROM stg_claim_payments WHERE payment_date >= DATE'2025-01-01' AND payment_date <= DATE'2025-12-31' GROUP BY claim_id) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.broker_code, d.lob_code) AS rows_affected, COALESCE(SUM(ABS((d.n - 1) * COALESCE(p.amt,0))),0) AS amount_affected FROM d LEFT JOIN pay p ON p.claim_id = d.claim_id

impact_query: WITH pol AS (SELECT policy_id, broker_code, lob_code FROM (SELECT s.policy_id, COALESCE(UPPER(TRIM(s.broker_code)),'DIRECT') AS broker_code, UPPER(RTRIM(p.lob_code)) AS lob_code, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.policy_id ORDER BY s.snapshot_date DESC, s._row_seq DESC) AS rn FROM stg_policy_snapshots s JOIN stg_products p ON p.product_code = s.product_code WHERE s.snapshot_date <= DATE'2025-12-31') x WHERE rn = 1), clm AS (SELECT c.claim_id, p.broker_code, p.lob_code FROM stg_claims c JOIN pol p ON p.policy_id = c.policy_id WHERE c.reported_date >= DATE'2025-01-01' AND c.reported_date <= DATE'2025-12-31'), d AS (SELECT claim_id, broker_code, lob_code, COUNT(*) AS n FROM clm GROUP BY claim_id, broker_code, lob_code HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), pay AS (SELECT claim_id, SUM(COALESCE(amount,0)) AS amt FROM stg_claim_payments WHERE payment_date >= DATE'2025-01-01' AND payment_date <= DATE'2025-12-31' GROUP BY claim_id) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.broker_code, d.lob_code) AS rows_affected, COALESCE(SUM(ABS((d.n - 1) * COALESCE(p.amt,0))),0) AS amount_affected FROM d LEFT JOIN pay p ON p.claim_id = d.claim_id
intended_behaviour: One row per claim_id (the latest by _row_seq) before counting and joining payments.
title: Duplicate claim rows multiply claims notified and claims paid

description: The in-force test uses expiry_date >= @AsOfDate. A policy whose expiry_date equals the as-of date counts as in force. If expiry_date is the exclusive end of cover (inception plus 12 months), such a policy has already lapsed.

impact.query: WITH pol AS (SELECT policy_id, broker_code, lob_code, inception_date, expiry_date, cancellation_date FROM (SELECT s.policy_id, COALESCE(UPPER(TRIM(s.broker_code)),'DIRECT') AS broker_code, UPPER(RTRIM(p.lob_code)) AS lob_code, s.inception_date, s.expiry_date, s.cancellation_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.policy_id ORDER BY s.snapshot_date DESC, s._row_seq DESC) AS rn FROM stg_policy_snapshots s JOIN stg_products p ON p.product_code = s.product_code WHERE s.snapshot_date <= DATE'2025-12-31') x WHERE rn = 1) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT broker_code, lob_code) AS rows_affected, COUNT(*) AS amount_affected FROM pol WHERE inception_date <= DATE'2025-12-31' AND expiry_date = DATE'2025-12-31' AND (cancellation_date IS NULL OR cancellation_date > DATE'2025-12-31')

impact_query: WITH pol AS (SELECT policy_id, broker_code, lob_code, inception_date, expiry_date, cancellation_date FROM (SELECT s.policy_id, COALESCE(UPPER(TRIM(s.broker_code)),'DIRECT') AS broker_code, UPPER(RTRIM(p.lob_code)) AS lob_code, s.inception_date, s.expiry_date, s.cancellation_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.policy_id ORDER BY s.snapshot_date DESC, s._row_seq DESC) AS rn FROM stg_policy_snapshots s JOIN stg_products p ON p.product_code = s.product_code WHERE s.snapshot_date <= DATE'2025-12-31') x WHERE rn = 1) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT broker_code, lob_code) AS rows_affected, COUNT(*) AS amount_affected FROM pol WHERE inception_date <= DATE'2025-12-31' AND expiry_date = DATE'2025-12-31' AND (cancellation_date IS NULL OR cancellation_date > DATE'2025-12-31')
intended_behaviour: If expiry is exclusive, the test should be expiry_date > @AsOfDate.
title: Policies expiring on the as-of date counted as in force
